scripts.dev:prepare: docker compose stop api worker && docker compose up -d postgres redis object-storage && npm run db:migrate
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis object-storage
scripts.infra:down: docker compose stop postgres redis object-storage
scripts.dev:api: cross-env NODE_ENV=development DATABASE_URL=postgres://xianyu:xianyu_dev_only@127.0.0.1:5432/xianyu_agent REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6379 ALLOW_IN_MEMORY=false COOKIE_SECURE=false XIANYU_QR_MODE=real npm --workspace apps/api run dev
scripts.dev:web: cross-env VITE_API_MODE=live VITE_API_BASE_URL= VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:8080 npm --workspace apps/web run dev
scripts.dev:worker: cross-env NODE_ENV=development DATABASE_URL=postgres://xianyu:xianyu_dev_only@127.0.0.1:5432/xianyu_agent REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6379 ALLOW_IN_MEMORY=false npm --workspace apps/api run dev:worker
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:chrome && npm run test:e2e:chrome:messages && npm run test:e2e:chrome:coupons && npm run compose:config && git diff --check
scripts.verify:agent-dynamics: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web && npm --workspace apps/web run test -- --run && npm --workspace apps/api run test:auto-reply:unit && npm --workspace apps/api run test:agent-dynamics:postgres && npm --workspace apps/web run build && npm --workspace apps/web run test:e2e:chrome:agent-dynamics && git diff --check
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.extract:seller-persona: npm --workspace apps/api exec -- node --import tsx scripts/extract-seller-persona.ts
scripts.test:extract:seller-persona: npm --workspace apps/api exec -- node --import tsx --test scripts/extract-seller-persona.test.ts
scripts.compose:logs: docker compose --profile full logs -f api worker
